name_zh: 厄瓜多尔·拉斐尔·科雷亚：公民革命与美元化中国阿桑奇庇护
name_en: Ecuador Rafael Correa: Citizen Revolution & Dollarization China Assange Asylum
description_zh: 拉斐尔·科雷亚 (1963-) 厄瓜多尔总统 (2007-2017)，公民革命重写宪法确立良好生活原则，美元化经济稳定依赖中国贷款，庇护阿桑奇对抗美帝国主义，2017年交权莫雷诺反水。
description_en: Rafael Correa (1963-) Ecuador President (2007-2017), citizen revolution rewrote constitution establishing Buen Vivir principles, dollarized economy stability dependent on Chinese loans, sheltered Assange against US imperialism, 2017 handover Moreno betrayed.
reason_zh: 科雷亚代表拉美左翼如何通过宪法重写与美元化稳定实现社会再分配，展示了中国替代性融资如何打破IMF垄断，阿桑奇庇护成为反美帝国主义符号，其交权后被前盟友背叛折射左翼传承脆弱性。
reason_en: Correa represents how Latin American left achieves social redistribution through constitutional rewrite and dollarization stability, demonstrating how Chinese alternative financing breaks IMF monopoly, Assange asylum becoming anti-US imperialism symbol, his handover betrayed by former ally reflecting leftist succession fragility.
steps_zh: 研究科雷亚早年比利时鲁汶大学经济学博士与反新自由主义
分析2008年制宪会议良好生活原则与自然权利
探讨美元化经济与中国贷款基建/石油换贷模式
评估2012年阿桑奇庇护伦敦使馆与美厄关系恶化
总结公民革命美元化中国阿桑奇庇护对拉美左翼的三重遗产
steps_en: Study Correa early Belgium KU Leuven economics PhD and anti-neoliberalism
Analyze 2008 Constituent Assembly Buen Vivir principles and nature rights
Explore dollarized economy and Chinese loans infrastructure/oil-for-loans model
Evaluate 2012 Assange asylum London embassy and US-Ecuador relations deterioration
Summarize citizen revolution dollarization China Assange asylum triple legacy for Latin American left
expected_zh: 理解宪法重写如何将土著良好生活理念制度化，掌握美元化与中国融资双重经济锚点的风险与收益，评估科雷亚遗产对拉美粉红浪潮退潮期的历史定位。
expected_en: Understand how constitutional rewrite institutionalized indigenous Buen Vivir philosophy, grasp dollarization and Chinese financing dual economic anchors risks and rewards, evaluate Correa legacy historical positioning for Latin American pink tide ebb period.
case_zh: 2007 总统；2008 宪法；2012 阿桑奇庇护；2017 交权。公民革命美元化中国阿桑奇范式永存。
case_en: 2007 President; 2008 Constitution; 2012 Assange asylum; 2017 handover. Citizen revolution dollarization China Assange paradigm endures.
intellectual_tradition: Latin American Left / Buen Vivir / Dollarization
cross_cultural_impact: Constitutional rewrite; dollarization; Chinese loans; Assange asylum
environmental_stewardship: 是: 自然权利/亚马逊
